summary: NovaBridge Biosciences filed a Form 6-K reporting the voting results of its September 8, 2026 Annual General Meeting, where shareholders approved the immediate removal of director Ms. Xin Liu. Of 121,294,288 shares present (44.8% quorum), 107,925,508 voted for removal, 13,313,327 against, with 55,453 abstaining. The removal is effective immediately upon resolution passage. No price, premium, or advisor details were given. What to watch: potential board composition shifts or related strategic actions following this abrupt governance change.
